newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian reform guru said ill with heart problems.
newsitem.headline: Russian reform guru said ill with heart problems.

text.p: Yevgeny Yasin, minister without portfolio and economics guru to the new team of young liberals in the Russian government, has been taken ill with what bankers said appeared to be heart trouble.

"I know that Yevgeny Grigorievich is not well. He's not at work today," a secretary in Yasin's office said after the minister did not turn up at a banking conference he had been due to address in Moscow on Monday.
She declined to say whether Yasin, 63, was in hospital or what was wrong with him.
Russian and western bankers at the conference said he had been taken to hospital with cardiac problems. "We understand he was hospitalised on Friday, with heart trouble," said one.
Yasin was Economy Minister until March, when he was replaced by his deputy Yakov Urinson in a reshuffle which brought in a team of youthful reformers tasked with boosting market reforms.

The diminutive economics professor, who has played a key role in negotiations with international financial organisations, became minister without portfolio in the new cabinet where he continued to coordinate reforms from behind the scenes.
